summary: Man drowned after cliff-jumping into Black Hole pond behind the Two Buttes Reservoir dam (~40 mi S of Lamar); resurfaced briefly then went under on Friday evening. CPW boat/sonar searched that night; CPW Marine Evidence Recovery Team with a submersible ROV recovered the body Saturday afternoon; Baca County Coroner took custody. Victim identity not released at publication.
location: Black Hole pond, Two Buttes Reservoir State Wildlife Area, below Two Buttes Reservoir dam
responding_agency: Colorado Parks and Wildlife officers; Baca County Sheriff deputies; CPW Marine Evidence Recovery Team; Baca County Coroner
notes: Row date 2022-07-22 = the Friday-evening incident/search start (article dated Jul 23, 2022; Friday/Saturday stated, weekday-verified). First Baca County row — fills Baca zero-row status. Source URL parent-opened 2026-09-15.
